profile.reading: Per Data Foundry own site, this Austin, Texas facility (Data Foundry 01, also called Texas 1) totals 150,000 square feet, combining 130,000 square feet of data center space with 20,000 square feet of dedicated customer office space, and provides 24 MW of power. The facility is audited to SSAE, HIPAA, PCI DSS, AICPA, and ISO 27001 standards. No street address is published on this page, only embedded map coordinates for the Austin location.

reading.body:
Data Foundry - Texas 1 in Austin, Texas, is operated by , but no IT capacity in megawatts has been published for this facility.

Without a published capacity figure, the facility cannot be sized against other data centers in this collection, or judged for whether it could plausibly host AI training infrastructure, which typically requires tens of megawatts and up. What is on record is the facility's location and operator, not its scale.

No compliance certifications are published for Data Foundry - Texas 1. That does not mean none exist, only that this site's dataset, built from the operator's own facility page, does not list any, which limits what regulated workloads a reader could confirm the facility is qualified to host.

Texas has 23 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which 15 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 399.41 MW.
